scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kokko/web build && cd apps/server && go build -o kokko .
scripts.check: biome check . && pnpm --filter @kokko/web typecheck && cd apps/server && go vet ./...
scripts.format: biome check --write . && cd apps/server && go fmt ./...
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @kokko/web test && cd apps/server && go test -race ./...
